rationale: The original preregistration fixed DEV policy selection but did not state an explicit H2 pass/fail gate. This addendum extends the same DEV retention/diversification principles before authoritative H2 replacement outcomes are opened.
applies_to: the single cooldown selected by the frozen DEV chooser; nonchosen cooldown H2 remains unopened
failure_action: Do not retune Top-K, cooldown, threshold, ATR cap, model heads, session mode or tie-break on opened H2 outcomes.
Demote current Consensus from Stable★6 replacement candidate to continuation/re-entry/pyramiding specialist research.
Keep V45 outcome-free ATR reference audit useful as a data-contract diagnostic, but do not use it to rescue V44.
success_action: Retain Consensus as a candidate normal-volatility specialist, not production-ready.
Run the already-preregistered outcome-free V45 full-context ATR reference audit.
Require later canonical-target retraining and prospective/shadow evidence before production consideration.
notes: The 80% retention and 25% concentration-reduction values are inherited directly from the original DEV selection rule rather than chosen from H2 replacement outcomes.
Baseline H2 Top-1 results were historically inspected, but authoritative replacement H2 outcomes have not been used to set this gate.
2026 outcomes are not part of this gate.
